title: i18n: the serving layer reads `defaultLocale`, not `i18n.sourceLocale`, as the authored label's language — with `defaultLocale: 'zh-CN'` and no `fallbackLocale`, an `en` request is served the zh-CN row instead of the English inline label
body:
domain:spec#2 · sunhaolin · session_017xRBcSbLCxEmyHf9upz3pz

Filing gate: ③ a follow-up that #33232 (PR #33357) reported out of scope. Contract review record 6882834204 (③, open question 1, answered A) found it owed before PR #33357 lands. The changeset, jsdoc and docs page of PR #33357 say "not yet read by the serving layer", and this card is where that "not yet" points.
Business reason: an app authored in English that defaults its users to Chinese (`defaultLocale: 'zh-CN'`, English inline labels, a zh-CN pack) serves English users the Chinese label, unless it also declares `fallbackLocale: 'en'`. Once PR #33357 lands and the app declares `sourceLocale: 'en'`, the coverage gate reports `en` as 100% covered while an `en` request still gets zh-CN.
Reader who acts: the owner of the label resolver seam: `packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts` `ResolveOptions.defaultLocale` ("the language its metadata labels are authored in"), and its callers.

## 维护者速读

用英文写元数据、给用户默认中文的应用，没配 `fallbackLocale` 时，英文用户看到的是中文标签。#33232 新增的 `sourceLocale` 目前只有命令行工具读取，运行时的标签解析还把 `defaultLocale` 当作原文语言。

## Measured (the #33232 dev, report 6881427009; not booted end to end)

- `packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts` `metaTranslateOptions` builds `{ locale, fallbackChain: [getFallbackLocale()], defaultLocale: getDefaultLocale() }`, and the REST metadata reads spread it into `@objectstack/spec/system` `translateObject`.
- On the built resolver, with `defaultLocale: 'zh-CN'` and no `fallbackLocale`: an `en` request for an object with inline label `Account` and a zh-CN row `客户` answers `客户`. With `fallbackLocale: 'en'` it answers `Account`.
- `serve.ts` collapses the fallback to `fallbackLocale`, else `defaultLocale` (review record 6882834204).
- The HTTP door (`GET /api/v1/meta/object/NAME` with `Accept-Language: en`) was not booted.

## Ask (the dev's option A, for the lane to judge)

Thread `i18n.sourceLocale ?? defaultLocale` into the serving layer as the authored label's language: the i18n service, `AppPlugin`, `metaTranslateOptions`, and the objectql and plugin-email option-label seams. A request in the source locale is then answered from the inline text. The dev estimated about 8 packages, medium work, and a contract widening of the i18n service.

## Dedupe

`repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue sourceLocale` → only #33232 (review record 6882834204). Related: #33232, PR #33357, #33231 (the console's user default).

⛔ Not a claim. Grading is triage's.
